newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen restarting Mon.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen restarting Mon.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 3 was expected to resume electricity production late Monday after tripping off line over the weekend, a company spokesman said.
"We expect it to return this evening, sometime during the early evening hours," spokesman Michael Wood said Monday.
Peach Bottom 3 tripped off line early Sunday while the unit was operating at reduced power for control rod adjustments, Wood said.
"The unit tripped as it was being reduced in power," the spokesman said.
The Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 2, also located in Delta, Pa., and with a capacity of 1,100 MW, was operating at full power Monday.
